overview: CropVibe is a Buyer + Seller agri-marketplace MVP: phone-OTP onboarding, dynamic category-driven listings, KYC-gated publishing and high-value checkout, idempotent UPI-first payments, a strict order state machine with payouts, and a minimal admin console (KYC queue, listing moderation, reports).
features: Phone + OTP auth with rate limiting and resumable single-track onboarding (Buyer or Seller)
Marketplace browse/search with category filters and KYC-verified seller badges
Multi-step listing creation driven by Category.attributeSchema (no per-category frontend code)
Client-side image blur/resolution check that flags but never blocks
Reusable KYC gate: structured 403 payloads open the KYC modal; fixed rejection-reason set with per-reason copy; 5-attempts-per-72h server-side cap; FRAUD_SUSPECTED hard block
Bank accounts via IFSC lookup + penny-drop validation; payouts only ever against VERIFIED accounts, scheduled after a configurable hold with commission
Idempotent checkout: replayed webhooks/retries upsert on idempotencyKey, never duplicating orders or payments
Order state machine enforced in one service function with per-role permissions, notifications and downstream effects (refunds, payout scheduling, dispute tickets)
Admin console (separate employee auth): isLatest-filtered KYC queue with confidence-derived priority, listing moderation, date-range reports
Config table for all business rules (thresholds, holds, caps, commission) — no magic numbers in handlers
